prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
All verified: LF line endings preserved, no BOM, trailing newline intact, and every file shows 262144 for fast-coder with no 131072 left anywhere.

[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code agree on fast-coder's context window (262144), permanently.

[action] The three configs in `out/` are generated from `models.json` by `gen.py` (per README.md). `models.json` had 131072 — the wrong value — while `out/opencode.json` had been hand-patched to 262144 after generation. I fixed the source of truth (`models.json`: 131072 → 262144) and re-ran `python gen.py`, which rewrote all three configs.

[result] Verified by grep across all four files:
- `models.json:3` → `"context_window": 262144`
- `out/opencode.json:9` → `"context": 262144`
- `out/codex.toml:2` → `context_window = 262144`
- `out/claude.json:5` → `"contextWindow": 262144`
- No occurrence of `131072` remains anywhere. All other model settings (deep-thinker 200000, tiny-chat 32768, all max_output/tool_calling values) are unchanged — confirmed by the same grep.

Why it's right: the configs are generated artifacts, so editing only `out/` would be reverted on the next `gen.py` run or install step. Fixing `models.json` and regenerating makes all three agree now and on every future generation. Assumptions: `models.json` is the authoritative source (README.md says `out/` is generated from it); "for good" means surviving regeneration, not just the current files. No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened.
